name: Extend Panel
description: Arabic-first mobile control panel for OpenClaw, opened from a private chat link.

panelUrl.description: Public https address the panel is reachable at. Only needed when the gateway sits behind a reverse proxy or tunnel.

linkTtlMinutes.description: How long a chat link stays valid. Defaults to 15 minutes.

sessionDays.description: How long a browser stays signed in after opening a link. Defaults to 30 days.

mountPath.description: Path the panel is served at. Defaults to /hooks/extend-panel, which Hostinger's proxy forwards without its own login.
